releases.body:
Publishes the two fixes that landed since `alpha.6`.

### Fixed

- The tools are registered with `codemode: false`, so `/recommend-models` and `/model-details` call `models_recommend` / `models_details` directly. On OpenCode 2 they defaulted to `codemode: true` and were reachable only from code written for the `execute` tool, so smaller models answered from memory or failed.
- The sidebar separator and model-id column are sized to the measured sidebar width instead of a hardcoded 40 cells, so rows no longer wrap onto a second line on narrow sidebars.
